sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the ship-owned conditional exception: cleanBallastMaterial and segregatedBallastMaterial require the typed boolean applicability result to be false, while retaining required single-valued applicability and valid classification range checks. No repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Require the applicability result property nltl:polarCodeOilDischargeParagraph1Point1Point1Applicable with sh:minCount 1 (and retain sh:maxCount 1); as written, a missing result produces no SPARQL focus row and therefore passes accidentally. Keep the check on the ship owner and preserve the typed false comparison for both controlled material values.
